title: Honey bee
author: Wikipedia contributors
attribution: Wikipedia contributors, “Honey bee”, English Wikipedia. Text available under CC BY-SA 4.0; see source history for contributors.
paragraphs: A honey bee (also spelled honeybee) is a eusocial flying insect from the genus Apis of the largest bee family, Apidae. Honey bees are known for their construction of perennial nests within cavities (i.e. beehives) containing hexagonal cells made of secreted wax, their large colony sizes, and their routine regurgitation of digested carbohydrates as surplus food storage in the form of honey, the lattermost of which distinguishes their hives as a prized foraging target of many mellivorous animals including honey badgers, bears and human hunter-gatherers.

Although honey bees represent only a small fraction of the roughly 20,000 known species of bees, they are the bee clade most familiar to humans and are also the most valuable beneficial insects to agriculture and horticulture. The best-known honey bee species is the western honey bee (Apis mellifera), which was domesticated and farmed (i.e. beekeeping) for honey production and crop pollination. The only other domesticated species is the eastern honey bee (Apis cerana), which are raised in South, Southeast and East Asia.

Only members of the genus Apis are true honey bees, but some other bee species also produce and store honey and have been kept by humans for that purpose, including the stingless bees belonging to the genus Melipona and the Indian stingless or dammar bee Tetragonula iridipennis. In addition to harvesting honey, modern humans also use beeswax in making candles, soap, lip balms and various cosmetics, as a lubricant and in mould-making using the lost wax process. Other honey bee secretions such as royal jelly and bee venom are used pharmaceutically, especially in alternative medicine.

sentence.translation: 虽然蜜蜂只占约两万种已知蜂类中的一小部分，但它们是人类最熟悉的蜂类分支，也是对农业和园艺最有价值的有益昆虫。
sentence.analysis: Although 引导让步状语从句，把‘物种占比小’与‘对人类重要’相联系。主句主语是 they，后面的 are…and are also…构成两个并列谓语。most familiar to humans 是形容词短语，后置修饰 the bee clade；roughly 是副词，修饰数字 20,000，表示‘大约’。

questions.prompt: 第二段开头使用 Although，主要强调蜜蜂的哪种特点？
options: 蜜蜂虽然只占蜂类物种的一小部分，却十分为人熟知且具有农业价值
蜜蜂虽然分布广泛，却没有成为人类熟悉的昆虫
蜜蜂虽然能产生蜂蜜，却无法为农作物授粉
蜜蜂虽然物种数量最多，却很少被人类驯养
questions.explanation: Although 从句指出蜜蜂仅占已知蜂类物种的一小部分；主句随后强调它们最为人类熟悉，并对农业和园艺非常有价值。让步结构突出的是数量占比与重要性之间的反差。

questions.prompt: 根据第三段，关于蜜蜂与产蜜蜂类，哪项说法正确？
options: 蜜蜂属之外的蜂类即使产蜜，也不会被人类为此饲养
Melipona 属的无刺蜂也被归入真正的蜜蜂
无刺蜂能制造蜂蜜，但不能把蜂蜜储存起来
蜜蜂属之外的某些蜂类也能制造并储存蜂蜜
questions.explanation: 第三段先说明只有 Apis 属成员才是真正的蜜蜂，随后用 but 指出‘some other bee species also produce and store honey’，并举无刺蜂为例。因此产蜜能力并非蜜蜂属独有。
